text: Mobile app development is a popular field today. When building an app, developers must think about responsive design so it works well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on both Android and iOS. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Performance is another key factor, because users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. A slow app is often deleted, so developers must test carefully before release.
